title: Render scroll-scale (Springs hero breathe)
source: springs.estate hero/place. Engine = library/components/render-scroll-scale (proven, owns_pin:false, pure set(p)).
engine: One full-bleed render in a fixed clipping frame that scales up (the reusable 'the hero image breathes/pushes' primitive). Pure set(p) scrub of the scale (+drift).
differs: Same scale mechanic + same pure set(p). TRIGGER differs: desktop scrubs the scale from scroll while the frame pins (reversible); mobile breathes the scale 0→1→0 over time on its own (ambient). Springs mobile has the hero breathe as a living background; desktop ties it to scroll.

desktop.driver: scrollScale — set(p) = scroll progress across the pin span (frame pinned).

mobile.driver: autoScale — set(p) breathes 0→1→0 over cycleMs, eased, looped.

engine_patch: forceMotion (skip <=820px static-lock; wrapper drives set(p) itself). owns_pin:false so no ScrollTrigger to bypass. See memory dual-platform-forcemotion.
entry: RenderScrollScaleDual.init(target, opts). Load engine.js THEN component.js. target = .rss-frame > img.rss-render. Desktop wraps in .pin-wrap for the pin.
law: transform (scale + translateY) only; frame overflow:hidden clips; GPU; NO width/height/top/left; NO WebGL. reduced-motion → static at scaleFrom.
